integrity: Proof explicitly separates exact previously known matching probabilities from newly assessed coupled extreme-value limit; deterministic tests do not certify asymptotics or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Complete graph with independent identical continuous edge laws only; the theorem does not transfer to geometric distances or heterogeneously weighted edges.
Joint convergence is established for two fixed normalized maxima, without a quantitative two-dimensional total variation error.
The full unmarked reciprocal-matching probability is prior published work; the threshold variant is a consequence of that work and exponential memorylessness.

The first_public_date is the verified initial public posting of the selected archived nearest-neighbor extremes source arXiv:math/0604599; Cooper and Frieze developed the random-link model in a 1995 journal article, earlier than that selected posting.
A more general unlocated random graph process theorem might imply an equivalent joint result.
title: Two independent extreme clocks in the symmetric random-link nearest-neighbor forest
